q: Should an unlisted MSME publish its emissions in its annual report?
title: Publishing emissions in an annual report
short: It is not required for an unlisted MSME, but a short, honest disclosure helps with lenders and buyers who ask anyway. Publish Scope 1 and 2, the method, what is estimated and one clear action. Do not publish a figure you have not checked, or a target you cannot track.

ul: Scope 1 and 2 totals and intensity per unit of output.
Period, sites covered and factors used.
One or two actions taken or planned.
Net zero claims without a plan.
Carbon neutral claims based on unverified credits.

p: Banks assessing green loans, large buyers checking suppliers under BRSR value chain rules, and future investors.

senseible: Senseible reads fuel, electricity and production documents into dated, fingerprinted plant records, so the monthly intensity behind a figure can be traced to its source.
